headline: BCRA Governor Projects Further Economic Growth and Ongoing Disinflation
summary: Central Bank of Argentina President Santiago Bausili stated in Córdoba that the economy is continuing its disinflation process, projecting another quarter of higher activity while defending central bank charter reform.
why: The Central Bank of Argentina is executing monetary reforms to curtail hyperinflation and stabilize the country's sovereign macroeconomic framework.
